The idea would be to develop a project on the **joint effect of selective logging and climate change on Amazonian forests dynamics**.

## Hypotheses

-   

## Data

-   IBAMA / G. Breda (lidar, log books, commercial inventories, and permanent plots on several large scale concessions)
-   Contact with Amazonian Concessions
-   TmFO Amazonian plots
-   Guyafor
-   ONF Guyane

## Tools

-   Bayesian modelling
-   TROLL
-   Canopy Construtor

## Approaches

-   Height and biomass modelling
-   Impact of modelling, emission and absorption in time, carbon balance
-   Practices effect (fine spatial scale modelling)
-   Climate effect projection
-   *Microclimate effect (e.g. MicroForest data)*
